title: Dilution Factor

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

expression: Dilution factor = Vsample / (Vsample + Vdiluent) = Vsample / Vfinal
explanation: Expresses how much a sample has been diluted, as the fraction of the final volume that came from the original sample. For serial dilutions, the cumulative dilution factor is the product of each individual step's factor.

workedExample.scenario: 1 mL of sample added to 9 mL of diluent.

commonMistakes: Confusing '1:10 dilution' (factor 0.1) with 'diluted 10-fold' phrased ambiguously — always double check whether a stated ratio describes sample:total or sample:diluent.
